name: Netherlands

nationalGame.name: Football
nationalGame.about: The Dutch invented 'Total Football' — a flowing style that changed the game forever. Oranje fans paint the country orange.
nationalGame.note: The Netherlands has no official national sport — football leads, with skating and korfball close behind.

loved.name: Football
loved.why: Streets turn orange when the national team plays.

loved.name: Speed Skating
loved.why: Dutch skaters sweep Olympic podiums on frozen canals.

loved.name: Korfball
loved.why: Invented here — mixed teams of boys and girls play together!

fact: On freezing winters the famous Eleven Cities race sends skaters along 200 km of frozen canals — it only happens when the ice is thick enough.
